The sky darkens from blue to indigo, streetlights flicker on along the median and lit office windows glow from above. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.
